messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Sparklyr with remote cluster when deployed on server
parts:
You may connect a shinyapps.io application to your own spark cluster, see the documentation on Firewalls

For general sparklyr questions, I would start off with http://spark.rstudio.com/deployment.html and then follow up on the shiny-discuss group.

There is no local spark cluster within shinyapps.io itself.
